reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so I don't need it packed to go. At $23k a year I'm not paying $25 to $30 a month for a convenience I don't really use.
objection: I take it at home at night anyway. Paying extra for sachets I don't need to carry feels like paying for packaging.
would_change_my_mind: A price close to what a regular bottle of magnesium costs, around $12 to $15 a month, or a trial box cheap enough to test whether I'd actually take it at the gym or while traveling.
